description: The car-wash funnel. The top of the page is now a staged progressive reveal: choose a business type (drifting band of all 52 + search) -> Diagnosis (reviewed trigger, 60-120 word paragraph, two valid business reasons) -> Meet your Virtual Role (overflow-first framing, HIPAA note only where flagged) -> Revenue Math with the preset auto-applied -> Book. Response library moved to schemaVersion 2 with a validating adapter and an honest 'we would rather ask than guess' fallback instead of boilerplate. Batch 1 content is in: 8 businesses drafted from the public OC VBRS files (automotive x7 + Spas), 44 show the honest fallback. Pool & Spa role corrected to Virtual Service Desk. Carousel demoted to browse-only. Reveal is visibility-triggered so the entrance can no longer complete off-screen.

approvedBuild.note: 011 remains the approved build. 012 is a structural rebuild of the top of the page and needs Eric's eyes-on review before approval.

qa.note: Playwright, tests/dassa-qa.spec.js, 27 tests x 7 viewport projects (desktop-1440, laptop-1024, tablet-768, mobile-430/390/320 touch, mobile-390 reduced-motion), run 2026-09-22 against the source tree. Full matrix: 153 passed, 1 failed, 35 skipped (each skip is a test that is by design pointer-only or touch-only). The one failure was test-side: the hover check targeted the nav CTA, which is display:none at 768px. Retargeted to the diagnosis stage's secondary button and re-run on all three pointer projects: 69 passed, 0 failed. Net: every test passes on every project it applies to. Verified: search->diagnosis, Next walk with heading focus on every stage (the 011 fixme is now a passing assertion), honest fallback, deep link + hash deep link, legacy pool-spa, back button and rail, business change resets downstream, Calendly prefill, carousel decoupled from the funnel, choreography wired and settles, reduced-motion zero-delay, band 52 chips / one tab stop / roving arrows / pause on hover / static under reduced motion, no horizontal overflow with every stage open at 320-1440, single-column role stage and stacked reason cards on phones, screen-reader status per stage, press and hover feedback, no console errors, zero library rejections. NOT verified by automation and still needs Eric: the wash choreography as actually perceived on laptop-1024 and a real phone, band drift speed and chip density at 390, and whether the 8 diagnosis paragraphs read in his voice (alternates in content-review/batch1-automotive-review-notes.md).
